name: Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of the Projected Positive No-Clashing Teaching Separation Class
proof: Assign $001,010,111$ respectively the positive one-example samples $(2,1),(1,1),(0,1)$. Each pair is prevented from clashing by one of these samples. Width zero is impossible for a non-singleton class. See sync/verify_projected_positive_noclashing_gap.py.
